messages:
anna-sales: FYI — FinSolve POC kicks off Mon. Need a billing org/project, hosted API keys, project quota and a spend cap. They might ask for Dedicated later. Any quick blockers?

mike-se: do they need Dedicated right away or is hosted fine for 2 weeks? also what's estimated token/day so ops can size quotas?

jess-ops: I can create the billing project and apply free credits + spend cap. Need: org_display_name, billing_contact_email, poc_start/end dates, estimated spend cap USD, and estimated tokens/day. Also note: Dedicated provisioning is 3-4 business days if they want reserved capacity.

ryan-devex: if they go Hosted we should set a project-level quota + API key tag and enable audit logging. For Dedicated/Private we need a PO and network contact for VPC peering if they want Private.

anna-sales: quick answers from the customer: org name "FinSolve POC", billing email "ops+finsolve@finco.com", POC 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14, est ~500k tokens/day, requested spend cap $500 for the POC. They'd prefer Dedicated eventually but ok to start on Hosted.

mike-se: perfect — hosted + quota works. I'll create a tagged API key and add a route with retry fallback to a smaller model if they hit cap. snippet for ops:```
POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/projects
{
  "name": "FinSolve POC",
  "tags": ["finsolve-poc"],
  "quota_tokens_per_day": 500000,
  "spend_cap_usd": 500
}
```

jess-ops: copying lines — creating project now and applying $500 promo credit with expiry 2026-06-14. Will set quota to 500k/day and enable audit logs. One question: do we need per-route token limits or just project-level?

anna-sales: project-level fine for now. Please also add a note to expire keys automatically at POC end.

jess-ops: got it. I'll provision hosted API key, tag it, enable logs, set quota 500k/day, spend cap $500, and set key expiration 2026-06-15. If they later sign for Dedicated, I'll open the Dedicated onboarding ticket and flag network tasks.

billing-bot: Billing project created: project_id=pj_01G8XYZ, promo_credit_id=pc_2026_FINSOLVE, spend_cap=500USD, quota=500000/day — contact jess-ops for changes.

ryan-devex: thanks. mike — can you add the fallback route and test prompt set? small regression test to ensure degrade gracefully.

mike-se: on it. tagging @anna-sales when done. :thumbsup:

anna-sales: awesome, thanks team. I'll update the customer and share the API key and usage dashboard link once jess confirms.
